segments.title: June
segments.text: Hello Kenkere House! June is Privates Month, with a side of Out of Office. Half our members are packing for holidays, the other half want results before they go. Either way, a trainer who knows your name is the answer.

segments.title: ₹10.53L
segments.text: So, the number. Our June target for Kenkere House is 10.5 lakh rupees. That's 15 per cent up on last June. A stretch, but a friendly one.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 5.58 lakh rupees. That's 5 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 3.58 lakh, everything else 73,700, and comebacks 63,200. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 53 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 786 leads, 283 trials, and 53 buyers, with about 19 per cent of trials converting. The trial class is where this month is won. Warm welcome, clear next step, every time.
Here's where the offers come in. Four offers carry 4.98 lakh rupees, which is 47 per cent of our target. The rest is full-price. Offers open the door. Great classes keep it open. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Happy Hour (Zero Hangover, All Glutes)
segments.text: First up, Happy Hour. Zero hangover, all glutes. Privates booked between twelve and four get twenty per cent off, plus a free virtual session for every two. The only thing on tap is a trainer. The plan is 16 buyers at about 6,600, so 1.06 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Members and newcomers buying private sessions.

segments.title: Private Practice
segments.text: Next, Private Practice. Ten private sessions at twenty-five per cent off, with one trainer who knows your knees better than your physio. The plan is 2 buyers at about 30,900, so 61,800 rupees.
segments.notes: Members and newcomers buying private sessions.

segments.title: Shy Girl Starter Pack
segments.text: Then, for the nervous newcomer, the Shy Girl Starter Pack. Start with a thirty-minute private, then join class with a trainer who already knows your name. Part of the price comes off the first month. The plan is 3 buyers at about 11,700, so 35,000 rupees.

segments.title: Auto-Reply: Out of Office, Still Squatting
segments.text: And finally, for travellers, Auto-Reply, Out of Office, Still Squatting. Three months with unlimited freezes and two virtual privates for the road. They're on vacation. Their membership isn't lapsing. The plan is 7 buyers at about 42,200, so 2.95 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: No price discount; ≈9% value from virtual privates

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, the private session offers go live, and trainers build their call lists. Week two, the happy hour push fills twelve to four. Week three, travellers renew with freezes, so nobody lapses on a beach. Week four, count every conversion and brief the monsoon plan for July.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's June at Kenkere House. 10.5 lakh rupees, four offers, and 53 buyers to welcome. Members on holiday, memberships on track. Lovely.
